indirectRouteWatch.title: AMIF Specific Action - Integration at Local Level - Italian national route
indirectRouteWatch.note: Cities/municipalities are eligible beneficiaries, but the national Managing Authority submits to the Commission. No specific official Italian public selection notice was located in the systematic search as of 2026-09-08; this is not a claim that no procedure exists.

correctlyExcludedOrNegativeControls.reason: Requires a rural region belonging to EUSALP/EUSBSR/EUSAIR/EUSDR. Tuscany is not in the Italian territories of those macroregional strategies relevant here.
PSLF projects must benefit territories covered by Territorial Just Transition Plans. Italian JTF territories are Taranto and Sulcis Iglesiente; Tuscany/Versilia is not covered.

Italian NIS2 local-public-administration scope includes metropolitan cities, municipalities over 100,000 inhabitants and regional capitals; Versilia municipalities do not qualify merely by being municipalities.
Smart-building topic does not document a municipality-specific role; municipal asset/demo involvement would need separate evidence.

structuralLessons: Programme-level source coverage does not imply topic/action-level coverage.
Innovation procurement (PCP/PPI) needs a dedicated lifecycle and buyer-group role model.
EU-funded third-party implementers and replicator-city calls need dedicated discovery beyond Commission domains.
A commissioned upstream service may imply a future downstream municipal EOI and should create a prospective sentinel.
Partner-only/unfunded participation must be distinguished from grant eligibility.
Geographic and regulatory negative controls are necessary to prevent false positives.
Detection-lag KPI must remain separate from eventual capture status.
